text: Creepy in places, especially the corridor changing length and the photographs coming out clean when she could see the stains with her own eyes. The deposition format was clever -- you can feel Renata trying to hold herself together while telling someone official about something that no official form can contain. But I did find myself wanting more from the ending. It just stops. I know that's probably the point, but after thirty years of reading these kinds of stories, I sometimes just want to know what happened. The historical bits were well done though. That debt ledger sat with me for a while.
